proof_obligations.PO-BE-CLASSICAL: Independently review mod-four feature source theorem and Hensel lifting. Binary errors must be fixed independently of A. Full rank and every lift/root check are required.
proof_obligations.PO-BE-STATE: Write the actual collective input/output density operators and retained environment; no substitution of binary errors for a broad Fourier envelope.
proof_obligations.PO-BE-ERROR-LAW: Derive the exact error distribution and its correlations from permitted native states. Single-translation local filters cannot pass the large-q success-weighted-fidelity bound.
proof_obligations.PO-BE-INFORMATION: If the bridge uses the full coordinate DFT intensity of any secret-independent Boolean envelope, apply the collision converse: arbitrary entanglement and public-A-dependent amplitudes cannot yield near-entropy-width high recovery from classical observations. A genuine A-adaptive subgroup-covariant measurement or another noise law needs an explicit physical construction, not a scope disclaimer.
proof_obligations.PO-BE-MARKER: For zero-to-target reduction, choose uniform marker independent of IID extended matrix and solver seed; do not leak marker/target/original-matrix side information. Charge extra arithmetic column and coverage loss.
proof_obligations.PO-BE-ALGEBRA: Respect two-power ring arithmetic and Boolean unit-gap witnesses. Fixed-prime field theorems, modulo-three relabeling or order-two gaps do not automatically transfer.
proof_obligations.PO-BE-COST: Runtime, memory, precision, preprocessing, all samples and herald probabilities must be polynomial in input bit length. No hidden dependence polynomial in q value.
proof_obligations.PO-BE-READOUT: Preserve target control, verified physical words and accessible program purification/inverse for the preferred direct filter; charge 2^-Delta and all cleanup projections. Excess density needs a different proved readout.
proof_obligations.PO-BE-BASELINES: Compare actual native arithmetic against meet-in-the-middle, lattice, algebraic, noisy-decoding and quantum filtering prior art under the same source/access and sample budget.
proof_obligations.PO-BE-COMPOSITION: Compose fixed-secret phase covariance, native lattice preparation, faults, fresh verification and approximation before a lattice or algorithmic speedup claim. Independent review and novelty audit remain separate gates.

An optimal decoder exceeds the collision bound on the declared independent classical-observation source.
Proposed collective transformation has wrong error support, exponentially small useful branch mass, nonphysical witness output or uncharged inverse access.
